verdict.rationale: Sierra's own blog says it uses outcome-based pricing, where customers 'pay only when the software achieves specific, valuable outcomes' (sierra-docs-26). That covers the core pricing model. Nothing in the evidence shows a public price list, a per-resolution rate, or spend caps and controls, so the 'not an opaque enterprise quote' part of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: published per-resolution pricing, spend caps or budget controls, evidence that pricing is transparent rather than quote-based, independent corroboration.
